key_note: Rocky v1.5 adds selectable desktop pets, each with its own animations, voice, and personality.
whats_new: Added a new Pet tab in Rocky Control Center
Added live character previews before saving a pet
Added three selectable pets: Rocky, Rhea, and Pip
Each pet now has its own animation folder, display name, voice, vibe, and system prompt
Changing pets now swaps the visible desktop character immediately
Changing pets also refreshes the Gemini Live session so the new voice and personality take effect
Updated packaged builds to include the pets folder correctly
